items.title: Weather Client 1.3.0: stability and tools
items.body: The crash in Limbo and AFK lobbies is fixed. Settings are now saved safely with automatic backups. A new Tools screen explains crashes in plain language, shows a live performance graph, keeps configuration profiles, and offers a Safe Mode for when the game will not start. The Hotbar Sorter was rebuilt to wait for the server before every move.

items.title: Weather Client has its own launcher
items.body: Sign in with Microsoft, press Play, and the launcher installs Minecraft 1.8.9, Legacy Fabric and Weather Client for you. Every file is hash-checked, and it keeps its own game folder, so your other installs stay untouched.

items.title: Fast Chunk Culling: +13-17% FPS
items.body: A rewrite of vanilla's chunk visibility search with flat arrays and a cached camera chunk. It draws exactly the same chunks as vanilla, 2.3x faster, and the slowest 1% of frames improve by over 20%.

items.title: Weather Client 1.2.0: aqua aurora
items.body: A new title screen with aurora curtains across the whole sky over a mountain lake, an in-client account switcher, and the aqua theme throughout the menus.

items.title: Five weather styles, crossfading
items.body: Rain, Snow, Blizzard, Fog and Sandstorm on the Weather On key. Snow settles on everything open to the sky and melts into the floor; rain leaves wet, reflective ground and drips down walls.

items.title: Storms you can call in
items.body: Thunderstorms roll in from the distance with procedural lightning bolts. Rain builds over about eight seconds and fades over twelve, and every part of the weather has its own slider.
